frozen_at: Phase-1, before any ReCoverMem outcome was observed

preference_form.name: implicit, choice-based
preference_form.selection_rule: first canonical implicit form under every ordering the repository exposes: (1) sorted directory listing of benchmark_dataset/implicit_preference/ -> 'choice-based' < 'persona-driven'; (2) argparse default in classification_task/benchmark_classification.py -> --pref_type default='choice'; (3) execution order in example_scripts/run_mcq_task.sh -> --pref_type=choice runs before --pref_type=persona. All three agree. Chosen from metadata/configuration only; no model outcome was consulted.
preference_form.explicit_form_excluded_because: its history construction requires an LLM-generated pref_generation acknowledgement turn
preference_form.persona_form: reserved for an appendix robustness check only; never counted as independent examples

history.construction: H_i = implicit choice-based conversation (4 messages) ++ filler[:600]
history.why_not_100_turns: 100 inter-turns is only ~1.06x the context limit; 300 gives 3.10x so the raw history provably cannot be passed to the answerer

statistical_unit.group_key: connected components over {shared normalized preference (mcq OR explicit wording)} U {shared normalized query}
statistical_unit.distractor_pool: fixed background shared by all instances; NOT an independently sampled history and never counted as a unit

correctness.gold_source: classification_task_options[0] (positional convention), shuffled per instance before exposure
correctness.shuffle: random.Random('prefeval-mcq-shuffle-v1::<pair_id>').shuffle -- id-derived because upstream's random.seed(41) is unreachable (NameError: random never imported)

baselines.note: the 44.6% longest-option floor was established structurally in Phase 0, before any method outcome, and must accompany every reported accuracy

routes.recovery: identical x_i + bounded evidence recovered from the ORIGINAL message-level history (<= B_rec)
routes.constraint: B_rec = B_mem; only the evidence source differs
private_never_exposed: preference field (implicit form states it nowhere)

gamma.note: correctness is binary {0,1}, so gamma=0.5 gives R = 1[correct]; retained for cross-setting consistency
